operation.summary: Listen for any sounds: whether the phone tells you when the room gets loud (8.23)
operation.returns: enabled, for_you, state (off|listening|paused), reason, sensitivity (quiet|normal|loud), send_clip, cooldown_seconds, max_seconds. Each sound arrives as a sound.heard event: heard_at, duration_seconds, peak_dbfs, mean_dbfs, sensitivity, clip_id, capture {capture_id, stored, url, memory_until, file}
